messages:
Anna (Support): FYI customer Jordan reported a sudden spike of 403s right after nightly API key rotation. They call the embeddings endpoint and some clients get 403, some succeed. ticket #SUP-9042. Payload from customer: 'insufficient_scope' in body.

Jordan (Customer): repro steps: used our hosted API key in header `Authorization: Bearer sk_XXXX` and hit POST /v1/embeddings. After rotation at ~2035012345 we saw ~30% of requests fail across regions. No changes on our side.

Devon (Oncall): tagging infra — @Mika can you check rotation job logs and Vault/KMS propagation? Also which gateway is authorizing tokens?

Mika (Eng Infra): looking. Quick notes: our rotation job creates a new API key record, writes secret to Vault kv v2 under `secret/data/apikeys/{id}`, then flips an alias in KMS and marks the old key as revoked. I see a rotation run at 2035012344 that created key id `k-907f` and marked previous `k-4a1c` revoked at 2035012345.

Mika (Eng Infra): Initial hypothesis: some front-line caches (edge CDN or API gateway) still had derived tokens/HMACs based on the old key and kept accepting them, while other clients were being rejected because we also flipped scope metadata in the DB. Searching logs for 'insufficient_scope' yields many responses from edge-proxy-3 in eu-west.

Devon (Oncall): can you paste the rotation command output?

Mika (Eng Infra): pastebin of logs: ```
rotation_job start 2035012340
created key k-907f scope:[embeddings,search:read]
wrote secret to vault secret/data/apikeys/k-907f
updated account record -> active_key=k-907f
revoked key k-4a1c
rotation_job end 2035012345
```

Lee (Security): I see the scope list for k-907f is missing `search:write` which older clients rely on (they use `search:write` for rerank/post-process). If some clients still used older key they kept write rights; new key is narrower. That would cause `insufficient_scope` when requests hit services expecting write. Why would some requests still succeed?

Mika (Eng Infra): turns out our edge CDN generates a short-lived HMAC token derived from the API key and caches that token for up to 5 minutes to reduce auth calls. The HMACs derived from k-4a1c propagated to a few POPs and still accepted by internal gateways that hadn't refreshed policy. The gateways consult the account metadata cache which refreshed at different intervals; inconsistency window explains mixed behavior. Also a subset of users use SDK v0.6 which sends `X-Api-Key` instead of Bearer; that path checks raw key directly against Vault and failed immediately for rotated keys.

Devon (Oncall): ok action plan to mitigate: 1) temporarily re-enable `k-4a1c` for write (set non-revoked) while we fix policy sync; 2) purge edge HMAC caches; 3) roll a quick rotation job that creates a k-907f2 with correct scopes; 4) add detection to rotation job to validate scope parity before revoking. Thoughts?

Lee (Security): re-enabling revoked keys is risky for audit/compliance but acceptable for a short hotfix if we log and limit to affected accounts. I approve a 10m window. @Mika please coordinate.

Mika (Eng Infra): performing steps now. Running purge: ```
curl -X POST "https://edge-admin.internal/purge" -H "Authorization: Bearer admin-token" -d '{"pattern":"hmac:k-*"}'
``` Purge request accepted. Also bumping account cache TTL to zero to force refresh on gateway nodes.

sre-bot: deploy 2035012401 by infra/rotate-hotfix started

Mika (Eng Infra): re-enabled k-4a1c in Vault (temp) and wrote note in audit. Starting controlled rotation to create k-907f2 with full scopes.

Mika (Eng Infra): created k-907f2 with scopes [embeddings,search:read,search:write], wrote to vault, updated account record active_key=k-907f2, then revoked both old keys except k-907f2. Verified edge purge completed.

Jordan (Customer): after purge and re-issue we saw success across all clients. Thanks. Response rate back to normal.

Devon (Oncall): long-term followups (Mika/Lee): - make rotation job validate desired scope set before revoking old key - change rotation to create new key + propagate alias update atomically before revoking old key - add pubsub notification so gateways/edge POPs can subscribe to rotations and invalidate HMAC caches instantly - add a pre-rotation smoke test that exercises both Bearer and X-Api-Key paths against a canary gateway node

Lee (Security): also add a policy guard: rotation jobs must include an explicit scope diff and a flag to allow narrowing scopes; disallow silent narrowing without manual approval. We'll open a Jira.

Mika (Eng Infra): opened INFRA-1182 for pubsub + atomic alias, INFRA-1183 for scope parity check in rotation, INFRA-1184 for adding smoke tests. I'll also add a short runbook for support: how to safely re-enable a revoked key (audit steps + TTL).

Anna (Support): closing the customer-facing escalation with note: hotfix applied (purge + recreate key), customer confirmed recovery. Will follow up with postmortem and link to INFRA tickets. :white_check_mark: 

Devon (Oncall): marking thread resolved but keeping infra tickets open for tracking. Thanks everyone.
